correctness.rationale: The proof reduces fixed points to C_T(U), writes the commutation equations explicitly, classifies the rank of the resulting 3-by-6 matrix for every diagonal-equality pattern, counts every stratum, divides by the scalar kernel, and applies Burnside exactly. The standalone verifier reproduces all four fixed-space multiplicities for q=2,3,5,7,11 and directly reconstructs all conjugation orbits for q=2,3. The finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-space spectrum is a complete structural invariant of the automorphism action, not a single numerical census. It converts classical innerness into an exact finite-field orbit formula and identifies the only four possible fixed-space dimensions. The Burnside consequence gives a natural, reusable count of upper-triangular similarity classes for the first nontrivial size where three interacting superdiagonal coordinates occur.
